Using the provided synthetic regulatory source document excerpt below, determine the current filing requirements, applicable license conditions, and any exemptions for NovaPay Ltd. Document your findings.

---
Aurelia Financial Conduct Authority (AFCA) Rule 2024-07, Section 3.2: 'All licensed payment institutions shall submit a Quarterly Transaction Report (QTR) within 15 business days after each calendar quarter. The report must include total transaction volume, number of transactions, and aggregate value by currency. Exemption: institutions with quarterly transaction volume below 10,000 transactions may file a simplified QTR.'
